title: Introduce inference signal orchestra: quantized cost bands, cohort heatmap, and alert prioritizer
author: Priya Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Operators need a compact, actionable surface that ties invocation-level telemetry (cost, latency, kernel occupancy) to hardware split and tenant cohorts so oncall can prioritize fixes without digging through long traces. This PR introduces the "signal orchestra" feature: a set of quantized cost bands, a cohort heatmap visualization, and an alert prioritizer that weights alerts by observed cost/latency impact.

Summary of changes: Adds a new dashboard (Observability -> Signal Orchestra) with a Sankey-style cost-lifecycle visualization, a cohorted heatmap keyed by prompt-shape/tenant/model, and trending quantized cost bands that map token-level cost buckets to backend resource splits (kernel/GPU/mem). Introduces a service-side decomposer that emits three new metrics (cost_band, cohort_id, hw_split) and enriches existing spans with cost_bucket tags. Provides an alert prioritizer that post-processes firing alerts and reorders alerts in the UI/Slack pager based on a weighted score (cost*latency*affected_tps). Includes a rollout plan with feature flagging, telemetry-driven canary thresholds, and an A/B comparison against current alert order.

Design notes: The cost quantization uses logarithmic bucketing with 7 bands to ensure stable cardinality while preserving tail resolution. Cohorts are derived from a lightweight fingerprint of the prompt shape + model family to avoid PII. hw_split tags indicate whether the token cost was dominated by kernel time, memory bandwidth, or host CPU. The alert prioritizer computes a normalized score per alert window and supports an override map for enterprise tenants. Implementation focuses on efficient tag emission (no additional RPCs during hot paths) by piggybacking on existing span finalizers.

Testing & performance: Unit tests for decomposer logic and deterministic cohort hashing included. Integration tests validate tag emission for sync/streaming responses and exercise dashboard queries against a synthetic replaybench. Perf microbench on dev cluster: end-to-end tail latency for streaming responses increased by ~0.6ms P50 (within SLO), token-cost metric emission adds <0.3% CPU at 95th percentile. Observed a 9% reduction in mean time-to-action in a simulated alert exercise when using prioritized alerts.

Rollout plan: 1) Deploy decomposer behind feature flag to 10% of requests and validate metrics ingestion. 2) Enable dashboard in read-only mode for internal tenants and collect feedback. 3) Flip prioritizer for internal oncall only (Slack/Console) for 2 weeks; monitor missed-severity regressions. 4) Full rollout after 4 successful Canary windows. Backout toggles exist for decomposer and prioritizer.

Checklist: - [x] Decomposer service + metrics emission - [x] Dashboard panels and saved queries - [x] Alert prioritizer service + config - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Runbook and rollback steps in runbooks/observability/signal-orchestra.md - [x] Linear tasks linked

Related: ENG-2042 (observability: cohort-based prioritization), ENG-2099 (alert fatigue: prioritizer prototype).

review_thread: Avery Chen: Nice work. Two requests: 1) can cohort fingerprint be made stable across restarts? 2) add a small opt-out for tenants with strict telemetry policies.
Priya Kapoor: Reply: cohort fingerprint uses a deterministic hash seeded with a topology-stable constant; added TENANT_TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT in defaults.yaml and documented in runbook.
Diego Martinez: Please add a short-circuit if hw_split is unknown to avoid creating high-cardinality tags.
Priya Kapoor: Added a fallback 'unknown' band and tightened the tag cardinality by enforcing the 7-band cap. Updated tests to assert cardinality bounds.
Leah O'Neill: UI nit: add a time-range pill to the cohort heatmap to make comparisons easier.
Priya Kapoor: Added a range selector to dashboard and a permalink example in docs.
release_notes: Add Signal Orchestra observability suite: quantized token cost bands, cohorted heatmap, and alert prioritizer. Backward-compatible; feature gated behind observability.signal_orchestra. Operators can triage alerts by impact (cost * latency * TPS).
notes_for_oncall: If prioritized alerts cause missing severity-1 signals, toggle alerts.prioritizer.enabled=false and notify infra-observability. Run replaybench with replay_id=signal-orchestra-20260226 to validate rollback.
